latest_release.name: v0.5.8
latest_release.body:
### 🌍 Lok 3

- _New_: Tasker/Macrodroid intents to automate start, stop, pause, resume *Advanced* mode WireGuards.
- _New_: *Configure -> Settings -> Packet capture* auto-turn off, auto-truncation, and manual delete option for `.pcap` captures.
- _New_: *Configure -> DNS -> Use System DNS on Captive Portals* to only use *System DNS* to get past captive portals auth.
- _New_: *IzzyOnDroid* flavour with a different package name (`com.celzero.bravedns.izzy`) to F-Droid (`com.celzero.bravedns`).
- _Improvement_: Reduced power use. Down from 5% - 10% to 2% to 3% in our tests.
- _Improvement_: Quick setting to bypass apps from RPN.
- _UI_: In *Advanced* mode, warn when client connects to the same WireGuard peer multiple times.
- _UI_: Text clipping issues on some devices.
- _Fix_: Handling of post-purchase device authorization and pre-purchase errors for RPN.

Note: *This is a fast-follow release, the last major release was [v057](https://github.com/celzero/rethink-app/releases/tag/v0.5.7).*
